name: Diva's Door AP
description: A loud aria in a soaring tenor issues from the door, sending soundwaves outward.
disable: DC 38 Performance (legendary) to cancel out the aria's soundwaves with another, DC 43 Thievery (master) to pick apart the arcane energies, or Dispel Magic (9th rank, counteract DC 36) to counteract the trap

offensiveAbilities.name: Resounding Aria
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the warehouse's double door without uttering the password

Effect All creatures within area C2 take (6d12+37) Sonic Damage damage (Basic DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw save); a creature that critically fails is permanently Deafened.
